cases.description: T0 Explorer row: the eye on 'Current model > Ducts' hides the Current model ducts temporarily in {3D}; duct terminals and the link stay visible
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' with the Architectural link and activate the 3D view '{3D}'.
Model Context panel, Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model': click the eye on 'Current model > Ducts'.
Revit shows the cyan 'Temporary Hide/Isolate' frame; ducts disappear, duct terminals and the linked building stay.
Click Reset in the panel's temporary bar: the frame goes away and the ducts are back.

cases.description: T0 Explorer row: Isolate on 'Current model > Ducts' leaves only the Current model ducts in {3D}
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: hover 'Current model > Ducts' and click Isolate.
Only ducts stay visible; the linked building and duct terminals are hidden; the temporary frame shows.
Click Reset: everything is back.

cases.description: T0 Explorer row: Color red on 'Current model > Ducts' overrides each duct inside Temporary View Properties
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: hover 'Current model > Ducts', click Color and pick red (230, 40, 40).
Ducts draw red; the view title shows Temporary View Properties; duct terminals keep their color.
Click Reset: the colors and the temporary properties mode are gone.

cases.description: T0 filter result: Color on the RF-01 result (ducts on level L3) colors those ducts only
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Filter tab: build RF-01 (Ducts, Reference Level equals L3) with only 'Current model' ticked.
Result row menu (...) > Color, pick green (40, 160, 60): the 319 ducts on L3 draw green, other ducts do not.
Click Reset in the temporary bar.

cases.description: T0 filter result: Hide on the RF-01 result hides the ducts on L3; ducts on other levels stay
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Filter tab: build RF-01 with only 'Current model' ticked.
Result row menu > Hide: the L3 ducts disappear inside the temporary frame.
Click Reset.

cases.description: T1 link model row: the eye on the Architectural link hides the whole link instance temporarily
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: click the eye on the Architectural link's model row.
The linked building disappears; HVAC ducts stay; the temporary bar shows 1 change.
Click Reset.

cases.description: T1 link model row: Isolate keeps only the Architectural link instance
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: hover the Architectural link row and click Isolate.
Only the linked building stays; the HVAC elements are hidden.
Click Reset.

cases.description: T1 link model row: Color overrides the Architectural link instance
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: hover the Architectural link row, click Color and pick blue (40, 90, 220).
The whole linked building draws blue; ducts keep their color.
Click Reset.

cases.description: T2 category eye: the eye on 'Ducts' in the Categories box hides the Ducts category inside Temporary View Properties (category visibility, which By Host View links follow), not with temporary hide
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: open Categories and click the eye on 'Ducts'.
The Ducts category is hidden (in the Current model and in links that follow the host view).
Click Reset.

cases.description: T2 category menu: Isolate on 'Ducts' in the Categories box hides every other category the view can hide (model, annotation, analytical, imports) inside Temporary View Properties; the Current model and every By Host View link then show only ducts, the link instances, the duct systems of the shown ducts and the listed categories Revit cannot hide; subcategories such as duct center lines count as their parent; Reset ends the mode and every count comes back
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: open Categories, click 'Ducts' (only Ducts stays ticked), right-click it and click Isolate.
Only ducts stay visible, in the Current model and in links By Host View; the view title shows Temporary View Properties.
Click Reset: everything is back.

cases.description: T2 category menu: Color on 'Ducts' in the Categories box overrides the Ducts category
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: open Categories, click 'Ducts' (only Ducts stays ticked), right-click it, click Color… and pick orange (230, 150, 20).
Every duct draws orange (category override in Temporary View Properties).
Click Reset.

cases.description: T2 category menu in links: Isolate on 'Doors' leaves only doors in the Current model and every By Host View link (active view collectors), besides the link instances and the listed categories Revit cannot hide in a view; the door count is unchanged; Reset brings every count back
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: tick the Architectural link, open Categories, click 'Doors', right-click it and click Isolate.
Only the doors stay; walls, floors, levels, lines and the HVAC ducts are gone.
Click Reset: everything is back.

cases.description: T3 filter result inside the link: Hide on the GR-02 result (12 Architectural doors) is planned as Hide in View (T3). L2 checks the plan only; running T3 inside the test runner crashed Revit
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Filter tab: build GR-02 (Doors, OR: Mark equals S10, Swing Angle undefined) with only the Architectural link ticked.
Result row menu > Hide: the 12 linked doors disappear (Hide in View, one undo entry, marked with the orange T3 dot).
Click Reset in the temporary bar: the panel shows them again.

cases.description: Linked elements sent by id: Color is refused (Revit colors linked elements only through a rule view filter, T4); nothing changes in the view

expected.error: Revit can color linked elements only by family, type or a rule filter.

manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Filter tab: build GR-02 with only the Architectural link ticked (its 'Swing Angle undefined' rule has no Revit filter rule).
Result row menu: Color is disabled and its tooltip gives the reason; nothing changes in the view.

cases.description: Mixed filter result: Hide on the GS-02 result splits into Current model ducts (T0, temporary hide) and Architectural doors (T3, Hide in View). L2 checks the split only
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Filter tab: build GS-02 with 'Current model' and the Architectural link ticked.
Result row menu > Hide: ducts disappear in the temporary frame and the linked doors disappear too.
Click Reset: both come back.

cases.description: T4 link type row: Color on the most used Architectural door type creates one 'Model Context <n>' rule view filter (Family Name + Type Name) inside Temporary View Properties with a red override; Reset deletes it and ends the mode
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: tick the Architectural link, open Doors > a family > its type row, right-click > Color… and pick red (230, 40, 40).
The linked doors of that type draw red; the tooltip says it applies to every By Host View link with this type.
Visibility/Graphics > Filters lists 'Model Context 1' while the temporary view properties are on.
Click Reset: the doors lose the color, the filter is gone from Manage > Filters and the mode ends.

cases.description: T0 + T4 mixed: Halftone on Current model ducts (element overrides) and an Architectural door type (rule view filter) in one plan; Reset removes both
manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: select 'Current model > Ducts' and a door type row under the Architectural link, right-click > Halftone.
Ducts and those linked doors draw halftone.
Click Reset.

cases.description: T4 cap: a link color request over 100 rules is refused before anything changes

expected.error: Over 100 rules to color in a link.

manualSteps: Activate '{3D}'. Explorer tab: select more than 50 type rows under the Architectural link, right-click: Color is disabled with the reason.

cases.description: T3 link isolate: Isolate on the GR-02 result (12 Architectural doors) is planned as a link isolate (temporary isolate of the link instance + Hide in View of the rest of that link in the active view). L2 checks the plan only
manualSteps: Activate a plan. Filter tab: build GR-02 with only the Architectural link ticked.
Result row menu > Isolate: only the 12 linked doors stay; the rest of the link is hidden (Hide in View, saved with the view) and the Current model is hidden temporarily.
Click Reset: the panel shows the rest of the link again and ends the temporary isolate.

cases.description: T0 + T3 mixed isolate: Isolate on the GS-02 result keeps the Current model ducts and the Architectural doors. L2 checks the split only
manualSteps: Activate a plan. Filter tab: build GS-02 with 'Current model' and the Architectural link ticked.
Result row menu > Isolate: the ducts and the linked doors stay; everything else is hidden.
Click Reset: everything comes back.
